# Scenario: digest-pinned image listed in ~/.trusted_images may bind-mount
# /var/run/docker.sock; deploy succeeds and writes trusted_image_deployed.
# Allowlist matching is case-insensitive; comments/blank lines are ignored.
# README Strict Volume & Socket Control / Trusted images / Events.

exec docker pull alpine:latest

# Resolve local RepoDigest once; compose uses canonical digest, allowlist uses UPPER case.
exec sh -c 'DIGEST=$(docker image inspect alpine:latest --format "{{index .RepoDigests 0}}"); test -n "$DIGEST"; printf "# trusted sock images\n\n%s\n" "$(printf "%s" "$DIGEST" | tr "[:lower:]" "[:upper:]")" > "$HOME/.trusted_images"; chmod 600 "$HOME/.trusted_images"; sed "s|__DIGEST__|$DIGEST|g" compose.sock.yml > git-repo/dev/e2e-sockok/docker-compose.yml; echo "trusted=$DIGEST"'

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: trusted docker.sock fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'trusted image deployed'
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-sockok-web
exists $HOME/.events
grep 'trusted_image_deployed' $HOME/.events
grep 'sha256:' $HOME/.events
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-sockok/docker-compose.yml
grep '/var/run/docker.sock' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-sockok/docker-compose.yml

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-sockok
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9983
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- compose.sock.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: __DIGEST__
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-sockok/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"

-- .env --
